logline: The Dowager Duchess realizes Juliana's wedding ring bears the Ashbourne crest belonging to her lost son, but before Juliana can reveal Alexander's name, Rupert and Catherine storm the bedchamber and frame her for poisoning the Duchess.
continuity_notes: Picks up immediately from Episode 26's cliffhanger where the Dowager Duchess gripped Juliana's hand upon recognizing the family signet ring, frantically questioning her origin.

scenes.heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tight close-up of the Dowager Duchess's aged, trembling hands clutching Juliana's hand, examining the worn metal band on her finger.

segments.label: DOWAGER DUCHESS (Shaken, Breathless)
segments.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
segments.text: This ring...

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle medium close-up of the Dowager Duchess lying propped against her pillows, gripping Juliana's wrist firmly as she gazes up in desperate demand.

segments.label: DOWAGER DUCHESS (Urgent, Demanding)
segments.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
segments.text: Look at me, girl. Who gave this to you?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Juliana in her maid's apron, startled and anxious as she answers.

segments.label: JULIANA (Hesitant, Sincere)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: My husband. He gave it to me when we wed.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low angle on the Dowager Duchess, her eyes burning with intensity.

segments.label: DOWAGER DUCHESS (Incredulous, Intense)
segments.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
segments.text: He is no commoner. What does he do?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana, trying to keep her composure.

segments.label: JULIANA (Earnest, Defending)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: He is a soldier. A veteran from the Peninsula.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium two-shot as the Duchess leans forward slightly, staring at the ring between their joined hands.

segments.label: DOWAGER DUCHESS (Trembling, Revelatory)
segments.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
segments.text: That is no ordinary band. It bears the Ashbourne crest.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Juliana, shaking her head in disbelief and growing confusion.

segments.label: JULIANA (Confused, Gentle)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: No. He lives in a barn. He has nothing but his word.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle shot on the Duchess, tears welling in her eyes as grief and shock overtake her.

segments.label: DOWAGER DUCHESS (Emotionally Strained, Weeping)
segments.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
segments.text: My lost son wore that exact ring. He went to war...

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana's eyes widening in stunned revelation.

segments.label: JULIANA (Shocked, Breathless)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Your son? He told me he was only a sergeant.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Side-angle medium shot of the bed, the Duchess holding onto Juliana's forearm with fierce insistence.

segments.label: DOWAGER DUCHESS (Desperate, Clinging)
segments.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
segments.text: My lost son wore that ring!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana looking down with compassionate concern.

segments.label: DOWAGER DUCHESS (O.S.) (Pleading)
segments.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
segments.text: Did your husband serve beside him?

segments.label: JULIANA (Soft, Reverent)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: He never spoke of his officers. He only spoke of survival.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of the Duchess gazing up at Juliana, her voice barely a whisper.

segments.label: DOWAGER DUCHESS (Hushed, Desperate)
segments.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
segments.text: What is your husband's name?

segments.label: SOUND FX
segments.text: Loud, violent pounding echoes on the wooden double doors.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Juliana gasps, snapping her head toward the entrance in alarm.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: The heavy mahogany double doors burst open, revealing the Blond Nobleman flanked by Lady Catherine and a royal guard in uniform.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Wide shot framing the open doorway as the aristocrats step into the dimly lit hallway.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Lady Catherine in her lavish cream gown and tiara, scowling with arrogant disdain.

segments.label: LADY CATHERINE (Sharp, Accusatory)
segments.speaker: LADY CATHERINE
segments.text: What is that maid doing in Her Grace's private chamber?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Juliana standing stiffly beside the bed, concealing her hands.

segments.label: JULIANA (Calm, Defiant)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: She needed help.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Lady Catherine narrowing her eyes with venomous suspicion.

segments.label: LADY CATHERINE (Piercing, Suspicious)
segments.speaker: LADY CATHERINE
segments.text: What are you hiding?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana, her chin raised.

segments.label: JULIANA (Firm)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Nothing.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of Lady Catherine pointing a white-gloved finger directly at Juliana.

segments.label: LADY CATHERINE (Demanding, Harsh)
segments.speaker: LADY CATHERINE
segments.text: Show me your hand.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of the Blond Nobleman stepping forward beside Lady Catherine, clad in a dark tailored coat with black leather gloves.

segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Cold, Authoritative)
segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
segments.text: Girl. Show me what you are holding.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Two-shot of Juliana facing the Blond Nobleman as she slowly extends her palm, revealing the small amber glass dropper bottle.

segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Skeptical)
segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
segments.text: What is this?

segments.label: JULIANA (Steady)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Medicine.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Lady Catherine tapping her gloved finger to her lip, letting out a mocking scoff.

segments.label: LADY CATHERINE (Mocking, Condescending)
segments.speaker: LADY CATHERINE
segments.text: Medicine? You are a new maid.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of the Blond Nobleman staring down at the vial, as Catherine sneers from his side.

segments.label: LADY CATHERINE (Incredulous, Accusing)
segments.speaker: LADY CATHERINE
segments.text: Who permitted you to give medicine to the Duchess?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana holding her ground.

segments.label: JULIANA (Quiet, Resolute)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: No one.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Lady Catherine turning fiercely triumphant.

segments.label: LADY CATHERINE (Spiteful, Indignant)
segments.speaker: LADY CATHERINE
segments.text: Then you administered it without permission.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana, her voice rising passionately.

segments.label: JULIANA (Passionate, Urgent)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Because she was dying!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of the Blond Nobleman pacing forward with calculating malice.

segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Cold, Interrogating)
segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
segments.text: And you decided you knew better than every physician in this house?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana retorting without hesitation.

segments.label: JULIANA (Fierce)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: The physicians were not saving her!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Over-the-shoulder shot past the Blond Nobleman looking toward the frail Duchess watching helplessly from the bed.

segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (O.S.) (Measured, Menacing)
segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
segments.text: My aunt has been wasting away for months.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of the Blond Nobleman turning slowly back toward Juliana, building his trap.

segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Smooth, Threatening)
segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
segments.text: And now we find an unknown maid alone beside her bed...

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up shot of his gloved black leather finger reaching down to tap against the glass dropper bottle in Juliana's open palm.

segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (O.S.) (Contemptuous)
segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
segments.text: ...holding a substance no one authorized her to give.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of Juliana raising the small bottle high for them to see.

segments.label: JULIANA (Unyielding)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: It is an antidote.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Lady Catherine sneering sharply.

segments.label: LADY CATHERINE (Sharp, Provocative)
segments.speaker: LADY CATHERINE
segments.text: An antidote to what?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Extreme close-up of Juliana's focused eyes.

segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (O.S.) (Stern, Barked)
segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
segments.text: Answer her.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on the Blond Nobleman's impatient scowl.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana speaking the truth clearly.

segments.label: JULIANA (Unyielding, Resolute)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Poison.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on the Blond Nobleman, his expression freezing into a dark scowl.

segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Whispering, Dangerous)
segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
segments.text: Poison.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana stating the grim reality.

segments.label: JULIANA (Urgent)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Someone has been poisoning Her Grace.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Lady Catherine turning abruptly to the guard stationed by the open door, pointing with feigned outrage.

segments.label: LADY CATHERINE (Shrieking, Feigning Horror)
segments.speaker: LADY CATHERINE
segments.text: You hear that?!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Lady Catherine twisting Juliana's words with malicious glee.

segments.label: LADY CATHERINE (Venomous, Accusing)
segments.speaker: LADY CATHERINE
segments.text: She admits she has been giving the Duchess poison in secret!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana recoiling in shock at the blatant lie.

segments.label: JULIANA (Desperate, Outraged)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: That is not what I said!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of the Blond Nobleman raising his black-gloved hand, silencing the room.

segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Authoritative, Icy)
segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
segments.text: Enough.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium two-shot as the Blond Nobleman steps into Juliana's personal space and plucks the glass dropper vial from her hand.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: The Blond Nobleman takes the medicine vial from Juliana's grasp, inspecting it under the candlelight.

segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Cold, Calculating)
segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
segments.text: An unknown servant enters a restricted chamber.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tight close-up of the Blond Nobleman holding the vial beside his temple, his blue eyes cold and triumphant.

segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Condemning, Vindictive)
segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
segments.text: She secretly administers an unidentified substance to a helpless woman.

segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (To Guard, Stern)
segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
segments.text: Take her.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Wide shot as the armed guard storms forward, seizing Juliana roughly by both arms.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: The guard twists Juliana around and drags her forcibly toward the doorway as she struggles against his grip.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Juliana being pulled backward, casting a frantic glance back toward the bedridden Duchess.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Extreme close-up of Juliana's wide, terrified eyes as she realizes the deadly trap closing around her, cutting abruptly to black.
